main_text.p: שָׁעָה Respexit, Attendit; sic construitur cum אֶל: Respicere ab aliquo, Avertere se, Desistere, Desistere ab aliquo, & sic construitur cum מִן vel מֵעַל: Item Oblectare se in re aliqua, & sic construitur cum בְּ: denique Illini, Oblini, Obduci, Inductum vel incrustatum esse instar parietis, & id à שַׁע vel שׁוּעַ petitum, quod Chaldaeis id significat. Pihel שִׁעְשַׁע Oblectavit vel Oblectatus fuit, Oblectavit se. Pyhal שְׁעְשַׁע Oblectari. Hithpahel הִשְׁתָּעָה Stupere, Obstupescere: & ex forma Pihel הִשְׁתַּעְשַׁע Oblectare se.
שָׁעָה f. Chald. Hora, sic dicta, quòd homines ad eam in suis actionibus Attendant & respiciant: כִּשְׁעָה Quasi horam, Dan. 4.16: בְּהָּ שַׁעְתָּא Eadem ipsâ hora, Dan.3.15.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel pointing and the running head are read roughly and may contain errors; the catchword and some points in the Hebrew entries are uncertain. Greek and Hebrew are transcribed as far as legible.
